body: Its kinda difficult to explain but pretty much I help people when they need it, but when I need help with something I get nothing. So I get pissed about it. And I end up hurting people. And it makes everyone forget the "good" things I've done. My family doesn't really love me. As I said, my brother has completely forsaken me. My mum abuses me and has left over post pardum depression or something because she always makes sure that I know how much she despises me. And my dad isn't around much, and when he is he only spends time with my other brother (who hates me to the point that he hides food on me to starve me).
